economies.name: GHKT-Separable Economy with Harrod-Neutral Knowledge (Economy A)
economies.tagline: The decarbonization transition as balanced growth of complementary sectors: green and dirty goods are unit-elastic complements, so the transition happens through green EFFECTIVE-productivity growth driven by continuously accumulated Romer-style knowledge, not through capital reallocation — and climate is an uninternalized exogenous BAU trend (laissez-faire benchmark).
economies.coupling_design: Four deliberate departures from production, each an alternative theory: (1) AGGREGATION: Cobb-Douglas utility over sector-specific goods, U = delta[theta_d log C_d + theta_g log C_g] with C_d=(A_d-i_d)K_d, C_g=(A_g-i_g-i_r)R^gamma K_g, replaces perfect substitutes. Unit elasticity means both sectors are always maintained (no bang-bang reallocation); this EXACTLY decouples the two capitals and kills the Z-coupling that makes production hard. (2) INNOVATION: knowledge is continuous Harrod-neutral green TFP (the R^gamma factor, Romer disembodied technology) instead of a Poisson lottery — R&D pays off deterministically and continuously; knowledge accumulates as a THIRD CAPITAL with the same log-adjustment-cost technology as physical capital (symmetric treatment: dlogR = psi_a log(1+theta_r i_r) dt + ...). (3) CLIMATE: temperature follows an exogenous BAU drift (dY = muY dt + sbar dW_y, muY = thetabar*eta*A_d*(1-Z0)*K0 = 0.01862 C/yr) — the planner's own capital does not move global temperature. This is the classic no-internalized-carbon-price benchmark: damages shape the VALUE function (full lambda3 curvature) but not investment. (4) ROBUSTNESS is structured: h distorts only the three endogenous accumulation channels (d,g,r), the exogenous climate shock stays risk. This is not cosmetic — including h_y triggers the Hansen-Sargent risk-sensitive Riccati breakdown for xi < 8*sbar^2*n2(l)/delta (=0.0674 at l=5, 0.0175 at l=2), i.e. the robust value is -infinity exactly in the deep-xi x high-lambda3 corner the lift must cover; restricting the distortion set is the theoretically grounded cure. Economically interesting because it is the closed-form pole of the GHKT tradition: smooth accumulation, complements, no jump risk, no carbon externality internalized.
economies.states_controls: States: logK_d, logK_g, logR, Y (Y a state with exogenous dynamics; lambda3-regime and xi enter as parameters, analytic in the solution). Process (exact SDEs): dlogK_d = [phi(i_d) - sigma_d^2/2] dt + sigma_d dW_d; dlogK_g = [phi(i_g) - sigma_g^2/2] dt + sigma_g dW_g with phi(i) = alpha + Gamma log(1+theta i), (alpha,Gamma,theta,sigma)=(-0.035,0.060,16.7,0.01); dlogR = [psi_a log(1+theta_r i_r) - sigma_r^2/2] dt + sigma_r dW_r with (psi_a,theta_r,sigma_r)=(0.62,16.7,0.0078) — psi_a,theta_r calibrated to match level and slope of the production logR drift psi0(i_r K/R)^{1/2} at (K0=880, R0=11.2, i_r~0.005); dY = muY dt + sbar dW_y with muY = 0.01862, sbar = 1.2*muY = 0.02234 (BAU reference-scale emissions E0 = eta*A_d*(1-Z0)*K0 = 10.01). Controls (3): i_d (dirty investment/K_d), i_g (green investment/K_g), i_r (R&D/K_g, funded from green output). Preferences: U = delta*theta_d[log(A_d-i_d)+logK_d] + delta*theta_g[log(A_g-i_g-i_r)+logK_g+gamma logR] - delta logN_regime(Y), theta_d=0.3, theta_g=0.7 (=initial capital shares), gamma=0.05 (knowledge elasticity of green services; gamma=0 post-tech: breakthrough exhausts the ladder). Damages logN(Y)=n0+n1 Y+n2 Y^2 per regime: pre-damage (0,lambda1,lambda2/2); post-damage(l) n2=(lambda2+lambda3(l))/2, n1=lambda1-lambda3(l)*yhat, n0=((lambda2+lambda3)/2)yhat^2, yhat=2.5.
economies.hjb: 0 = -delta V + max_{i_d,i_g,i_r} min_{h_d,h_g,h_r} { delta theta_d[log(A_d-i_d)+logK_d] + delta theta_g[log(A_g-i_g-i_r)+logK_g+gamma logR] - delta logN_l(Y) + V_lKd[phi(i_d)-sigma_d^2/2+sigma_d h_d] + (sigma_d^2/2)V_lKd,lKd + V_lKg[phi(i_g)-sigma_g^2/2+sigma_g h_g] + (sigma_g^2/2)V_lKg,lKg + V_lR[psi_a log(1+theta_r i_r)-sigma_r^2/2+sigma_r h_r] + (sigma_r^2/2)V_lR,lR + V_Y muY + (sbar^2/2)V_YY + (xi/2)(h_d^2+h_g^2+h_r^2) }. After the closed-form minimization h_j = -(1/xi)sigma_j V_x_j, the h-block collapses to -(1/2xi)[sigma_d^2 V_lKd^2 + sigma_g^2 V_lKg^2 + sigma_r^2 V_lR^2]. No jump terms: the tech lottery is replaced by continuous knowledge, and the four production regimes correspond to four parameterizations (A_g, gamma; n0,n1,n2(l)). Structured robustness: no h_y (see coupling_design for the breakdown theorem that motivates it).
economies.solution: CLOSED FORM by guess-and-verify V = theta_d logK_d + theta_g logK_g + b logR + q0 + q1 Y + q2 Y^2 + v0. Matching logK_d: -delta a_d + delta theta_d = 0 => a_d = theta_d; a_g = theta_g; matching logR: b = gamma*theta_g = 0.035 (pre-tech; b=0 post-tech). FOCs are then CONSTANT-coefficient: (i) delta theta_d/(A_d-i_d) = theta_d Gamma theta/(1+theta i_d) => i_d* = (Gamma theta A_d - delta)/(theta(delta+Gamma)) = 0.103131; (ii)+(iii) jointly: from delta/c_g = Gamma theta/(1+theta i_g) and delta/c_g = gamma psi_a theta_r/(1+theta_r i_r) (theta_g cancels in all three FOCs), substitute into c_g = A_g - i_g - i_r to get the LINEAR equation c_g[1+(Gamma+gamma psi_a)/delta] = A_g + 1/theta + 1/theta_r, so c_g* = 0.022600, i_g* = (Gamma theta c_g*/delta - 1)/theta = 0.075716, i_r* = (gamma psi_a theta_r c_g*/delta - 1)/theta_r = 0.010184 (interior iff gamma psi_a theta_r c_g* > delta). Post-tech: same formulas with A_g''=0.1567, gamma=0: i_g'' = 0.125760. Y-block (linear ODE since no h_y): q2 = -n2(l), q1 = -n1(l) - 2 n2(l) muY/delta, q0 = [-delta n0 + q1 muY + sbar^2 q2]/delta; pre-damage q2 = -0.00220, q1 = -0.008369; post-damage l=5: q2 = -0.16887, q1 = +0.20433 (slope sign flips below yhat because the vertex shifts — full curvature carried). Constant: v0 = (1/delta)[delta theta_d log(A_d-i_d*) + delta theta_g log c_g* + theta_d(phi(i_d*)-sigma_d^2/2) + theta_g(phi(i_g*)-sigma_g^2/2) + b(psi_a log(1+theta_r i_r*)-sigma_r^2/2) - (1/2xi)(sigma_d^2 theta_d^2 + sigma_g^2 theta_g^2 + sigma_r^2 b^2)] — the only place xi enters (theorem-like byproduct: with log-separable structure, robustness moves the value LEVEL, not investment). Everything analytic in (xi, lambda3).
economies.verification: Four checks, three already RUN (script scratchpad/verify_zoo_closed_forms.py): (1) algebraic substitution: HJB residual evaluated at 200 random states per xi in {0.05,0.1,1e8} for pre-damage and 100 for post-damage l=5 — max|residual| = 2.1e-17 (machine zero); (2) FOC check by central-difference gradient of the Hamiltonian at (i_g*,i_r*): |grad| ~ 3e-11; (3) limit checks: q2 -> -n2 and q1 -> -lambda1 - lambda2 muY/delta exactly; xi -> infinity reproduces the uncertainty-neutral value; gamma -> 0 collapses i_r to the documented corner; (4) to add: sympy symbolic residual == 0 (10 min) and a Monte-Carlo consistency check (simulate 10k paths under i*, verify realized discounted utility matches V at the start point to sampling error). Breakdown thresholds for the h_y extension documented and reproduced numerically (xi* = 8 sbar^2 n2/delta = 0.0009/0.0175/0.0674 for pre/l=2/l=5).
economies.lift_map: Production point x = (logK, Z, Y, logR, logxi [, lambda3]) maps bijectively to economy states via logK_d = logK + log(1-Z), logK_g = logK + logZ (exact; Z-box [0.01,0.99] keeps logs finite) — NO state is collapsed in pre-tech regimes; post-tech drops logR exactly as the production layout does. Per regime (OneJump 4-regime layout): v(x) = logK + theta_d log(1-Z) + theta_g logZ + 1{pre-tech} gamma theta_g logR + q0(reg,l) + q1(reg,l) Y + q2(reg,l) Y^2 + v0(reg, xi), with (n0,n1,n2) from the regime's damage coefficients — so the lambda3 input enters ANALYTICALLY through q0,q1,q2 and the logxi input enters analytically through v0 (evaluate xi = exp(logxi)). Policies: i_d-net(x) = 0.103131 (constant); i_g-net(x) = 0.075716 pre-tech / 0.125760 post-tech; i_r-net(x) = Z * 0.010184 in BOTH pre-tech regimes — NONTRIVIAL: the economy's i_r is per unit GREEN capital, production's is per unit TOTAL capital, so I_r = i_r^A K_g = (i_r^A Z) K, giving a Z-dependent field of exactly production scale (0.0071 at Z=0.7). Distortion fields if needed by the anchor fit: h_d = -(1/xi)theta_d sigma_d, h_g = -(1/xi)theta_g sigma_g, h_r = -(1/xi)gamma theta_g sigma_r, h_y = 0. Known omission, documented: no damage-jump anticipation in the pre-damage v (the economy has no jumps); the map is a coherent economy's exact solution, not an approximation of production.
economies.plots: (1) Value damage block: g_l(Y) = q0+q1 Y+q2 Y^2 on Y in [0,4], six curves (pre-damage + post-damage l=1..5), annotated with the slope-matching at yhat=2.5 — shows the full lambda3 curvature family the lift feeds the lambda3 input. (2) Policy panel: closed-form i_d*, i_g*, i_r* and c_g* as functions of gamma (comparative static, benchmark gamma=0.05 marked, corner gamma_min = delta/(psi_a theta_r c_g) shown) plus the v0(xi) level curve on logxi in [log 0.01, log 150] — displays that policies are xi-flat while the level is not. (3) Lifted fields on production axes: heatmaps of v and i_r-net = 0.010184*Z over (Z, logR) at Y=1.1 and over (Z, Y) at logR=2.4, PreDamagePreTech layout — the exact panels make_fd_anchor.py will consume.
economies.expected_distinctness: Attacks three axes on which the production attractor and prior maps are known to differ (memory: box-family finding, loss-decomposition finding). (1) V_logK == 1 exactly — the theoretical BGP unit slope; the production trained attractor sits at in-box V_logK ~ 0.37-0.79. A map with unit slope plus the level v0 pins a different point of the level/slope solution family. (2) V_logR = 0.035 constant > 0 with an i_r field ACTIVE everywhere — the opposite pole from Economy B's V_logR = 0 (the two members bracket the knowledge-valuation axis, which the loss-decomposition study identified as the LARGEST cross-run divergence channel). (3) V_Z = theta_g/Z - theta_d/(1-Z), zero at Z = theta_g = 0.7: an interior-share-favoring shape (complements) versus the production family's monotone-in-Z shapes — steers toward a balanced two-sector basin rather than the dirty over-accumulation attractor. Policies xi-flat and Y-flat (i_d = 0.103 everywhere, no climate response) make this the laissez-faire pole: if training from this map still converges to decarbonization, the basin story sharpens; if it lands in a dirty basin, that is the economically-labeled contrast the zoo is designed to exhibit.

economies.name: Aghion-Howitt Patent-Race Economy with Growth Damages (Economy B)
economies.tagline: The transition as a winnable race: breakthroughs arrive as a memoryless Poisson hazard purchased by current R&D effort (creative destruction, no knowledge stock), warming permanently erodes GROWTH rates (Dell-Jones-Olken) rather than utility levels, and the breakthrough's payoff is both higher green productivity and a slower warming drift — while robustness endogenously chokes R&D because the worst-case belief is that the breakthrough never comes.
economies.coupling_design: Four departures, orthogonal to Economy A's: (1) INNOVATION: memoryless patent-race hazard Lambda(i_r) = rho_b log(1+theta_r i_r) replaces the knowledge stock — the AH creative-destruction pole versus A's Romer accumulation pole and production's stock-driven hazard. This is an EXACT reduction of the knowledge state: in the zeta->infinity fast-depreciation limit of the production R-process, R* = (psi0/zeta)^{1/psi1} i_r K (quasi-steady state linear in R&D flow), and dividing the arrival units by economy scale (strong Jones-style dilution: bigger economies need proportionally more research) gives a hazard in the RATE i_r alone. (2) DAMAGES: temperature reduces capital-accumulation DRIFT (dlogK_j carries -kappa Y dt, kappa=0.001/C on both sectors) instead of utility level — the growth-vs-level damage debate; compounding makes V_Y = -kappa/delta = -0.100, twelve times steeper than the level-damage value slope (~-0.008). (3) CLIMATE PAYOFF OF INNOVATION: the jump lowers the warming drift (muY: 0.01862 -> 0.25*0.01862), so R&D directly buys a cooler future — a coupling absent from production, where the jump only changes A_g. (4) JUMP ROBUSTNESS ACTIVE IN CLOSED FORM: the distortion g* = exp(-Delta/xi) and the robust jump premium P(Delta,xi) = xi(1-e^{-Delta/xi}) saturate at xi, producing the economy's signature: i_r* rises from a corner (i_r = 0 for xi < 0.044) through 0.0063 at xi=0.05 to 0.0542 at xi=infinity — robustness devastates lottery-motivated R&D. Uses the same Cobb-Douglas separable aggregation as A (the price of exactness), but every other coupling differs from both A and production.
economies.states_controls: States: logK_d, logK_g, Y, plus the tech regime n in {pre, post} (the quality-ladder position IS the knowledge state) and damage regime/lambda3 as parameters. Process: dlogK_d = [phi(i_d) - kappa_l Y - sigma_d^2/2] dt + sigma_d dW_d; dlogK_g = [phi(i_g) - kappa_l Y - sigma_g^2/2] dt + sigma_g dW_g (growth damages; kappa_pre = 0.001, post-damage kappa_l = 0.001*(1+3*lambda3(l)) so l=5 doubles the hit); dY = muY^n dt + sbar dW_y, muY^pre = 0.01862, muY^post = 0.25*muY^pre, sbar = 0.02234; tech jump: Poisson with intensity Lambda(i_r) = rho_b log(1+theta_r i_r), (rho_b, theta_r) = (0.40, 16.7) (rho_b set by the interiority condition xi rho_b theta_r > delta theta_g/c_g^{i_r=0} at xi = 0.05), jump sends A_g 0.1085 -> 0.1567 AND muY^pre -> muY^post, absorbing (OneJump pi=1; the 6-regime version repeats the same algebra per stage). Controls (3): i_d, i_g, i_r (R&D per unit green capital, funded from green output: C_g = (A_g - i_g - i_r)K_g; i_r active pre-tech only). Preferences: U = delta theta_d log C_d + delta theta_g log C_g, theta_d = 0.3, theta_g = 0.7; no utility damage (damages are in the drift). Robustness xi on all four Brownian channels (h_y IS active here — no breakdown because V is linear in Y) plus the jump-intensity distortion g.
economies.hjb: Pre-tech: 0 = -delta V + max_{i_d,i_g,i_r} min_{h, g>=0} { delta theta_d[log(A_d-i_d)+logK_d] + delta theta_g[log(A_g-i_g-i_r)+logK_g] + V_lKd[phi(i_d) - kappa Y - sigma_d^2/2 + sigma_d h_d] + (sigma_d^2/2)V_lKd,lKd + V_lKg[phi(i_g) - kappa Y - sigma_g^2/2 + sigma_g h_g] + (sigma_g^2/2)V_lKg,lKg + V_Y[muY^pre + sbar h_y] + (sbar^2/2)V_YY + (xi/2)|h|^2 + Lambda(i_r) g [V^post - V] + xi Lambda(i_r)[1 - g + g log g] }. Closed-form minimizers h_j = -(1/xi) sigma_j V_j, g* = exp(-(V^post-V)/xi); substituting gives -(1/2xi)[sigma_d^2 V_lKd^2 + sigma_g^2 V_lKg^2 + sbar^2 V_Y^2] + xi Lambda(i_r)[1 - e^{-(V^post-V)/xi}]. Post-tech: same with A_g'' = 0.1567, no i_r, no jump term, muY^post. The i_r FOC couples marginal green consumption to the ROBUST jump premium: delta theta_g/c_g = P(Delta,xi) Lambda'(i_r), P = xi(1-e^{-Delta/xi}).
economies.solution: CLOSED FORM up to one scalar monotone fixed point. Guess V^n = theta_d logK_d + theta_g logK_g + q1 Y + V0^n. logK matching gives the theta coefficients as in A; Y matching in BOTH regimes gives -delta q1 - (theta_d + theta_g) kappa = 0 => q1 = -kappa/delta = -0.100, REGIME-INDEPENDENT — hence the jump gap Delta = V0^post - V0^pre is a CONSTANT in the state, which is exactly what closes the model (state-independent Delta => state-independent i_r => log-linear matching survives; self-consistent because permanent growth damages have regime-independent marginal cost). Policies: i_d* = 0.103131 (same closed form as A); post-tech i_g'' = (Gamma theta A_g'' - delta)/(theta(delta+Gamma)) = 0.125760, c_g'' = 0.030940. Pre-tech, GIVEN Delta: P = xi(1-e^{-Delta/xi}); c_g(P) = (A_g + 1/theta + 1/theta_r)/(1 + Gamma/delta + P rho_b/(delta theta_g)); i_g = (Gamma theta c_g/delta - 1)/theta; i_r = (P rho_b theta_r c_g/(delta theta_g) - 1)/theta_r, floored at 0 (corner for xi < xibar ~ 0.044 where xibar solves xi rho_b theta_r = delta theta_g/c_g^{0}). Constants: delta V0^post = delta theta_d log(A_d-i_d*) + delta theta_g log c_g'' + theta_d phi(i_d*) + theta_g phi(i_g'') - (1/2)(theta_d sigma_d^2 + theta_g sigma_g^2) + q1 muY^post - (1/2xi)(sigma_d^2 theta_d^2 + sigma_g^2 theta_g^2 + sbar^2 q1^2); delta V0^pre(Delta) = same with (c_g(P), i_g(P), muY^pre) plus the option-value flow Lambda(i_r(P)) * P(Delta). Fixed point: Phi(Delta) = V0^post - V0^pre(Delta) - Delta = 0; Phi is strictly decreasing (V0^pre increasing in Delta via the option value, by the envelope theorem), Phi(0) > 0 (post regime strictly better: higher A_g, cooler drift), Phi(50) < 0 => UNIQUE root, bisection/Newton converges globally. Solved values: xi=0.05: Delta*=1.360, i_r*=0.00628, i_g*=0.07906, Lambda=0.0399/yr (E[time to breakthrough] 25y); xi=0.1: Delta*=0.656, i_r*=0.0426, i_g*=0.0479, Lambda=0.215/yr; xi=inf: Delta*=0.122, i_r*=0.0542, i_g*=0.0380, Lambda=0.258/yr — note i_g falls as aversion vanishes (R&D crowds green consumption within the green budget).
economies.verification: Script scratchpad/verify_zoo_closed_forms.py, already RUN: (1) HJB residual at 200 random (logK_d, logK_g, Y) states per xi in {0.05, 0.1, 1e8}: max|residual| <= 2.1e-17 (machine zero) with the fixed-point Delta*; (2) exact FOC check: -delta theta_g/c_g + P Lambda'(i_r*) = 0 to 6e-17; (3) uniqueness: sign bracket Phi(0)>0>Phi(50) verified, 200-step bisection; (4) cross-check against repo memory: the post-tech block reproduces the S1 steady-state derivation numbers EXACTLY (i_g''=0.1258, c*=0.0309, growth 0.0329) since the FOC coincides at Z=1; (5) limits: xi->inf gives P->Delta (uncertainty-neutral jump valuation), kappa->0 kills q1, rho_b->0 collapses pre-tech to the no-R&D two-sector economy; (6) to add: sympy identity check and a jump-simulation Monte Carlo (simulate the two-regime economy, verify realized value and arrival frequency Lambda(i_r*) against the formulas). economies.lift_map: Production x = (logK, Z, Y, logR, logxi [, lambda3]) with logK_d = logK + log(1-Z), logK_g = logK + logZ. Per regime: v(x) = logK + theta_d log(1-Z) + theta_g logZ + q1(l) Y + V0^{reg}(xi, l), where q1(l) = -kappa_l/delta uses the regime's growth-damage coefficient (pre-damage kappa; post-damage kappa_l = kappa(1+3 lambda3(l)) — the lambda3 INPUT enters analytically) and V0 is evaluated at xi = exp(logxi) via the fixed point (tabulated once on a logxi grid, spline-interpolated — still exact economy-wise). logR is COLLAPSED (v flat in logR): this is deliberate and hypothesis-bearing — it initializes V_logR = 0, the opposite pole of Economy A, on the axis the loss-decomposition study flagged as the largest cross-run divergence. Policies: i_d-net = 0.103131 everywhere; i_g-net(x) = i_g*(reg, xi) (pre-tech xi-dependent: 0.0791/0.0479/0.0380 at xi = 0.05/0.1/inf; post-tech 0.12576); i_r-net(x) = Z * i_r*(xi) in both pre-tech regimes — NONTRIVIAL through BOTH the Z conversion (I_r = i_r^B K_g = i_r^B Z K) and the steep xi profile (0.0063 -> 0.0542 across the xi range; clipped to 0 below xibar ~ 0.044 with the corner documented as an economic prediction, not a numerical artifact). Distortions if the anchor fit wants them: h_y = -(1/xi) sbar q1 (constant per regime), g* = exp(-Delta*/xi) (clipped exponent). Known omission, documented: no damage-jump anticipation (damage regimes solved standalone), same convention as Economy A.

economies.expected_distinctness: Three engineered contrasts, each aimed at a documented axis of the solution family: (1) V_logR == 0 versus Economy A's +0.035 and the production attractor's large positive knowledge valuation — the zoo members bracket the V_logR axis that the RUNA/RUNB loss decomposition identified as the biggest divergence channel (8-34% of the value gap), so if the basin is selected by the initialization's knowledge valuation, A and B MUST land differently. (2) V_Y = -0.100, an order of magnitude steeper than both Economy A (-0.008) and the production family's level-damage slopes: a growth-damages map teaches the network climate URGENCY at initialization and should steer toward an aggressive-decarbonization basin — the opposite pull from A's laissez-faire climate. (3) Strongly xi-DEPENDENT policy fields (i_r spans an order of magnitude across the logxi input, i_g co-moves oppositely) versus A's xi-flat policies and the production attractor's mild xi profile: trains a different logxi-direction gradient into the control nets from step one. Together with A this gives a 2x2 of (knowledge valued, climate ignored) vs (knowledge lottery discounted, climate urgent) — clean economic labels for whatever basins training delivers.

critique.math_errors: Economy A: post-damage constant n0=((lambda2+lambda3)/2)*yhat^2 breaks value continuity of logN at yhat=2.5 by exactly (lambda2/2)*yhat^2=0.01375 (verified numerically; correct n0=(lambda3/2)*yhat^2 gives machine-zero continuity given their n1,n2) — misplaces all post-damage value LEVELS q0 by ~+1.375 v-units after /delta, material for a level-selection program. Everything else in A re-derives clean (i_d*=0.103131, c_g*=0.022600, i_g*=0.075720, i_r*=0.010180, q-coefficients, h_y Riccati thresholds xi*=8*sbar^2*n2/delta=0.00088/0.0175/0.0674 all confirmed). Economy B: no equation errors found — independent fixed-point solve reproduces the full table (Delta*=1.360/0.656/0.122, i_r*=0.00628/0.0426/0.0542, Lambda=0.0399/0.215/0.258, xibar=0.0436), q1=-kappa/delta regime-independence closure is correct; but the 'EXACT reduction' claim for the hazard is false (production has zeta=0, not zeta->inf, and even that limit gives a hazard linear in i_r*K, not log(1+theta_r*i_r) with dilution) — a framing overclaim, not algebra.

economies.name: INTENSITY economy (scale-free innovation + carbon-intensity climate; exact logK-homogeneous reduction)
economies.tagline: The Jones/semi-endogenous theory of the transition: neither breakthrough arrival nor warming responds to the SIZE of the economy — only to its intensities (knowledge per unit of capital R/K, dirty share 1−Z) — so decarbonization is governed by composition, not scale, and the marginal value of log-capital is pinned near 1.
economies.coupling_design: Two couplings change relative to production, both in the same 'no scale effects' direction. (a) INNOVATION: tech-jump intensity is knowledge INTENSITY, J_g = e^{s}/rho_tilde with s = logR − logK and rho_tilde = (R0/K0)/(R0/varrho) = 0.8485, instead of production's J_g = R/varrho (scale effect: doubling the economy doubles arrival). Calibrated so the t=0 hazard equals production's 0.0150/yr exactly. This is the Jones critique of fully-endogenous growth applied to green R&D: labs matter per unit of economy, not in absolute number. (b) CLIMATE: emissions are intensity-based, E_tilde(Z) = eta_tilde·A_d·(1−Z) with eta_tilde = eta·K0 = 256.08, instead of eta·A_d·(1−Z)·K — temperature responds to the carbon intensity of production (the policy-relevant object in intensity-targeting regimes), calibrated to match production's t=0 temperature drift exactly (E0 = 10.01). Everything else — log utility, AK, log adjustment costs, full nonlinear damages logN(Y; lambda3) with the damage jump at y_hat = 2.5, robustness (xi), all parameter values — is IDENTICAL to production. Economically interesting because it isolates the production model's central identification ambiguity: whether growth itself accelerates both the problem (emissions) and the cure (arrival). Here it does neither, and the value function is provably logK + W.
economies.states_controls: PROCESS (4 endogenous states, exactly as production except the two intensity couplings): dlogK = [(1−Z)phi_d(i_d) + Z·phi_g(i_g) − ½((1−Z)²sig_d² + Z²sig_g²)]dt + (1−Z)sig_d dW_d + Z sig_g dW_g;  dZ = Z(1−Z)[phi_g − phi_d + (1−Z)sig_d² − Z sig_g²]dt + Z(1−Z)(sig_g dW_g − sig_d dW_d);  dY = E_tilde(Z)(thetabar dt + varsigma dW_y), E_tilde = eta_tilde·A_d·(1−Z);  dlogR = [psi0·i_r^{psi1}·e^{−psi1·s} − ½sig_r²]dt + sig_r dW_r (zeta = 0), s := logR − logK. Jumps: tech at intensity e^{s}/rho_tilde (pi = 1 OneJump, or pi = 0.04 split l'/l''), damage at (1/L)J_n(Y) revealing lambda3. REDUCED STATES: (Z, Y, s) with ds = mu_R − mu_K dt + sig_r dW_r − (1−Z)sig_d dW_d − Z sig_g dW_g. CONTROLS (all three active): i_d, i_g, i_r with consumption c = C/K = (A_d − i_d)(1−Z) + (A_g − i_g)Z − i_r. Robust minimizers h_{d,g,r,y}, g^{l,l',l''} in closed form. Pseudo-parameters: xi in {0.05, 0.1, 148.4}, lambda3(l), l = 1..5 (parameter sweep, not states).
economies.hjb: EXACT ANSATZ V(logK,Z,Y,logR) = logK + W(Z,Y,s). Proof of exactness: logK appears in the 4-D HJB only through +delta·logK (utility) and −delta·A·logK (discounting of the ansatz) — coefficient matching forces A = 1 and leaves NO residual logK dependence, because mu_K, mu_Z depend only on (Z, controls), the Y-drift is scale-free by design (a), the tech hazard is scale-free by design (b), s-dynamics depend only on (s, Z, controls), and every post-jump value has the same form so V^l − V = W^l − W is logK-free. REDUCED 3-D HJB (pre-damage pre-tech; write mu_K = (1−Z)phi_d + Z phi_g − ½[(1−Z)²sig_d² + Z²sig_g²], mu_R = psi0 i_r^{psi1} e^{−psi1 s} − ½sig_r², mu_Z = Z(1−Z)[phi_g − phi_d + (1−Z)sig_d² − Z sig_g²], and robust loadings L_d = (1 − W_s − Z W_Z)(1−Z)sig_d, L_g = (1 − W_s + (1−Z)W_Z)Z sig_g, L_r = W_s sig_r, L_y = W_Y E_tilde varsigma):   0 = max_{i_d,i_g,i_r} { delta·log c − delta·logN(Y) − delta·W + mu_K·1 + (mu_R − mu_K)·W_s + mu_Z·W_Z + thetabar·E_tilde·W_Y + ½Z²(1−Z)²(sig_d²+sig_g²)·W_ZZ + ½[sig_r² + (1−Z)²sig_d² + Z²sig_g²]·W_ss + Z(1−Z)[(1−Z)sig_d² − Z sig_g²]·W_Zs + ½varsigma²E_tilde²·W_YY − (1/2xi)(L_d² + L_g² + L_r² + L_y²) } + xi·(e^{s}/rho_tilde)[1 − e^{−(W^{post} − W)/xi}] + xi·Sum_l (1/L)J_n(Y)[1 − e^{−(W^{(l)} − W)/xi}].  (Note the standalone +mu_K term = mu_K·V_logK's unit part; no Y-cross second derivatives since W_y is independent of W_d, W_g, W_r.) FOCs: delta/c = phi_d'(i_d)[1 − W_s − Z W_Z]; delta/c = phi_g'(i_g)[1 − W_s + (1−Z)W_Z]; delta/c = psi0·psi1·i_r^{psi1−1}·e^{−psi1 s}·W_s — the i_r FOC has EXACTLY production's functional form (e^{psi1(logK−logR)} = e^{−psi1 s}) with V_logR |→ W_s, so i_r is genuinely active, i_r* = [psi0 psi1 e^{−psi1 s} W_s c/delta]^{1/(1−psi1)} (a square for psi1 = 0.5). Regime table: PostDamagePostTech and PreDamagePostTech drop s and i_r → 2-D W(Z,Y); the two pre-tech regimes are 3-D W(Z,Y,s); solve backward through the jump tree exactly as production.
economies.solution: FD-3D, direct clone of the verified PIBYS pattern in benchmarks/post_damage_post_tech/fd_pdpt_v5_stable.py, with state (Z,Y,s) replacing (logK,Z,Y). Grid: Z in [0.02,0.98] (61), Y in [0,4] (31), s in [−6, 0] (41) covering the production box image (logR in [1,6], logK in [4,7] ⇒ s in [−6,2]; s>0 is economically vacuous, verified by boundary-sensitivity). Scheme: Howard policy iteration — (i) policy evaluation by the repo's finite-horizon discounted Feynman–Kac rollout (simulate_v pattern, T = 1200, dt = 2.5, e^{−12} truncation, capped/reflected states at box edges per the Y_CAP pattern); (ii) closed-form FOC control update (repo `controls` for i_d, i_g from q_d = 1 − W_s − Z W_Z, q_g = 1 − W_s + (1−Z)W_Z, plus the explicit i_r* formula, jointly with the c constraint by the repo's inner fixed point); (iii) relax = 0.3, tail-averaging K = 6, interior-pocket stopping tol 1e-6, final mutual-consistency gate — all byte-pattern from v5_stable. Cross terms W_Zs (cov = Z(1−Z)[(1−Z)sig_d² − Z sig_g²], O(1e-4)) handled centrally inside the rollout as v5 already handles V_{logK,Z}. WHY UNIQUE: the reported object is the Feynman–Kac value = expected discounted utility under the candidate policy — policy evaluation is a strict delta-contraction on the bounded box, Howard improvement is monotone, and the mutual-consistency gate certifies the fixed point; this selects THE discounted-utility solution, not an arbitrary member of the bounded-box residual family (the box-family multiplicity afflicts residual-only training, not Feynman–Kac evaluation with explicit boundary treatment). Solve order: 2-D PostDamagePostTech (5 lambda3) → 2-D PreDamagePostTech → 3-D PostDamagePreTech (5 lambda3) → 3-D PreDamagePreTech; each at xi in {0.05, 0.1, 148.4} (the −1/(2xi) drag stays exactly 3-D since all loadings are (Z,Y,s)-functions). ~18 cheap 3-D solves + 18 2-D solves per tech tree (OneJump); interm regime adds one 3-D layer for pi = 0.04.
economies.verification: (1) ALGEBRAIC EXACTNESS: sympy substitution of V = A logK + W into the full 4-D HJB; assert the logK coefficient is delta − delta·A identically in (Z,Y,s, controls) ⇒ A = 1 and zero residual logK terms (script checked into the economy dir). (2) TRUE-RESIDUAL: max|reduced-HJB residual| on the grid (repo _residual pattern), target <= 1e-3 interior; report the mutual-consistency gate_int. (3) RICHARDSON: grid refinement 31→61→121 per axis (fd_v5_richardson pattern), confirm first-order-consistent convergence of v, i_d, i_g, i_r at reference points. (4) UNREDUCED CROSS-CHECK (the decisive one): a coarse 4-D FD of the UNREDUCED intensity economy (15^4 grid, same PIBYS evaluation) — verify V_4D(logK,Z,Y,logR) − logK collapses onto W(Z,Y,logR−logK) along s-level sets to discretization error; this certifies the reduction numerically, independent of the algebra. (5) CLOSED-FORM CORNER ANCHOR: at Z→1 post-tech there are no emissions and the HJB degenerates to 1 state; the exact corner policy i* = (Gamma·theta·A − delta)/(theta(Gamma + delta)) gives i_g* = 0.12576, growth phi = 0.03289, W0 = log(A''−i*) + (phi − ½sig_g²)/delta = −0.1919 (numerically confirmed above, and matching the repo's sympy-exact S1 BGP memory 0.1258/0.0328); check the FD extrapolates to it. (6) LIMITS: xi = 148.4 solve vs a neutral (drag-off) solve agree to O(1/xi); hazard-off (rho_tilde → inf) pre-tech solve converges to the post-tech-with-A_g solve, W_s → small, i_r → 0.
economies.lift_map: Production nets per regime: v, i_d, i_g (+ i_r in the two pre-tech regimes); inputs (logK, Z, Y[, logR], lambda3 where applicable, logxi duplicated to pad width). LIFT at an arbitrary production input x: compute s = clip(logR − logK, [−6, 0]) (pre-tech regimes; post-tech regimes have no logR input and no s), read xi from the single logxi (dedup the padding copies), then: v_target(x) = logK + W_regime(Z, Y, s; lambda3, xi) — trilinear interpolation on the FD grid, linear in logxi across the 3 xi-solves and linear in lambda3 across the 5 damage solves (post-damage regimes); apply the repo's per-regime ±logN value transform exactly as models_terminal_anchor/make_fd_anchor.py consumes it. Policies: i_d_target(x) = i_d^{FD}(Z,Y,s;lambda3,xi), same for i_g; i_r_target(x) = i_r^{FD}(Z,Y,s;lambda3,xi) in BOTH pre-tech regimes — NONTRIVIAL by construction: i_r* = [psi0 psi1 e^{−psi1 s} W_s c/delta]², strongly increasing as s falls (high marginal product of R&D when knowledge intensity is low) and shaped in (Z,Y) through c and W_s; at s0 = −4.364 it is interior and of production magnitude since the FOC form is identical to production's. SHARED STATES: Z, Y exact. COLLAPSED: (logK, logR) enter W and all policies only through s; along s-level lines v is exactly affine in logK with slope 1 (i.e., the lift asserts V_logK = 1 − W_s at every production point) and policies are constant. Post-tech regimes: v = logK + W(Z,Y;lambda3,xi), policies (Z,Y) only — no i_r net exists there, consistent.
economies.plots: (1) Value/knowledge field: heatmaps of W and W_s over (s, Z) at Y = 1.1 and Y = 2.5 slices (pre-damage pre-tech, xi = 0.1) — shows the knowledge-intensity gradient that drives i_r. (2) Policy fields: i_d and i_g over (Z, Y) at s = s0 = −4.364, and i_r over (s, Y) at Z = 0.7 — displays the damage-jump kink near y_hat and the e^{−psi1 s} R&D ramp. (3) Reduced-state paths: simulate (Z_t, Y_t, s_t) from (0.7, 1.1, −4.364) under the FD policies; plot i_d, i_g, i_r, Z, and hazard e^{s}/rho_tilde vs t for xi in {148.4, 0.1, 0.05} — the economy's own transition narrative (does knowledge intensity build or dilute as K grows?).
economies.expected_distinctness: The lift hard-codes V_logK = 1 − W_s ≈ 0.95–1.0 uniformly across the box — the near-unit marginal value of log capital that characterizes the FD-verified decarbonizing member of the box family (v_lK ≈ 0.95, level 6.45, de-invests), and is maximally far from the trained attractor's basin (v_lK ≈ 0.37, level 4.27, dirty over-accumulation). It also seeds policies that are exactly constant along logK at fixed (Z, Y, s) — an intensity-logic policy geometry no other zoo member or production-trained net has — and an i_r field whose only capital dependence is through s. If training preserves basin membership under identical gentle training (the program's established premise), this map should deliver the high-v_logK decarbonizing basin; if the attractor still captures it, that is itself the cleanest possible demonstration that the attractor overrides even an exactly-solved scale-free warm start.

economies.name: LINEAR-SCC SCALE economy (GHKT-style linear damages, exact Y-elimination, scale-dependent social cost of carbon)
economies.tagline: The Golosov–Hansen–Krusell–Tsyvinski theory of the transition: damages are log-linear in temperature so the shadow price of warming is a CONSTANT (V_Y = −lambda1_eff) and Y drops out of the fixed point exactly — but emissions and breakthrough arrival scale with the LEVEL of capital, so the mitigation motive is a social-cost-of-carbon term that grows like e^{logK} and the marginal value of capital DECLINES with scale.
economies.coupling_design: The mirror image of the INTENSITY economy: it KEEPS production's scale effects (emissions eta·A_d·(1−Z)·K, tech hazard R/varrho = e^{logK+s}/varrho — both level-dependent) and instead changes the DAMAGE channel: logN(Y) = lambda1_eff·Y, linear (lambda2 = lambda3 = 0), with the damage jump replaced by its certainty equivalent folded into the slope — a family lambda1_eff(regime, l) obtained by matching production's marginal damage (logN)_y at a reference temperature Y_ref = 3: lambda1_eff = lambda1 + lambda2·Y_ref pre-damage (≈ 0.013 mild) up to lambda1 + lambda2(Y_ref − y_hat + y_bar) + lambda3(l)(Y_ref − y_hat) (≈ 0.18 for l = 5) post-damage — spanning mild-to-CE-severe variants (the zoo's calibration-family 'level mover' knob). Economically this is the canonical tractable climate-economy benchmark: linear marginal damages make the SCC proportional to output/capital, so mitigation intensifies as the economy GROWS — 'grow into mitigation' — the opposite transition theory to the intensity economy, and different from production (which has convex damages + jump fear concentrated near y_hat). The auxiliary structure is that the entire climate block enters the fixed point as one closed-form source term −lambda1_eff·thetabar·eta·A_d·(1−Z)·e^{logK}: the flow SCC per unit time, explicit in the states.
economies.states_controls: PROCESS (4 endogenous states): dlogK, dZ, dlogR (with zeta = 0) EXACTLY as production; dY = eta·A_d·(1−Z)·e^{logK}·(thetabar dt + varsigma dW_y) exactly as production (varsigma kept at 1.2·1.86/1000 — the y-shock survives the reduction, see HJB). Damages: −delta·lambda1_eff·Y in utility, linear; NO damage jump (its expectation lives in lambda1_eff). Tech jump: intensity e^{logK+s}/varrho, varrho = 746.67, pi = 1 (OneJump) or 0.04 — production's scale-effect innovation, unchanged. REDUCED STATES: (k, Z, s) with k := logK, s := logR − logK — dimension 4 → 3 by exact elimination of Y (below); note (logK, logR) → (k, s) is a bijection, the reduction removes Y only. CONTROLS: i_d, i_g, i_r, all active, c = (A_d − i_d)(1−Z) + (A_g − i_g)Z − i_r; robust h_{d,g,r,y} and tech-jump g in closed form, xi in {0.05, 0.1, 148.4} as parameters.
economies.hjb: EXACT ANSATZ V(logK,Z,Y,logR) = logK − lambda1_eff·Y + Phi(k, Z, s). Proof of exactness: (i) Y-flow terms −delta·lambda1_eff·Y (utility) and +delta·lambda1_eff·Y (from −delta·V) cancel identically, for ANY controls, since no FOC involves Y; (ii) V_Y = −lambda1_eff constant ⇒ the Y-drift term becomes the closed-form SCC source −lambda1_eff·thetabar·eta·A_d·(1−Z)·e^{k}, a (k,Z)-function; (iii) V_YY = 0 kills the varsigma² diffusion term; (iv) the robust y-channel survives exactly: h_y = (lambda1_eff/xi)·varsigma·E contributes −(1/2xi)·lambda1_eff²·varsigma²·(eta A_d)²(1−Z)²e^{2k}, again a (k,Z)-function; (v) the tech-jump gap V^{post} − V = Phi^{post} − Phi is Y-free because lambda1_eff is common across tech regimes (damage slope is a climate property, not a technology property); (vi) logK terms delta·logK − delta·logK cancel, and Phi is allowed to depend on k, so no homogeneity is imposed. REDUCED 3-D HJB (pre-tech; mu_K, mu_R, mu_Z as in Economy 1 but with mu_R = psi0 i_r^{psi1}e^{−psi1 s} − ½sig_r²; var_K = (1−Z)²sig_d² + Z²sig_g², var_Z = Z²(1−Z)²(sig_d²+sig_g²), cov_kZ = Z(1−Z)[Z sig_g² − (1−Z)sig_d²], cov_Zs = −cov_kZ, cov_ks = −var_K; robust loadings L_d = (1 + Phi_k − Phi_s − Z·Phi_Z)(1−Z)sig_d, L_g = (1 + Phi_k − Phi_s + (1−Z)Phi_Z)Z·sig_g, L_r = Phi_s·sig_r, L_y = lambda1_eff·varsigma·eta·A_d(1−Z)e^{k}):   0 = max_{i_d,i_g,i_r} { delta·log c − delta·Phi + mu_K·(1 + Phi_k − Phi_s) + mu_R·Phi_s + mu_Z·Phi_Z − lambda1_eff·thetabar·eta·A_d·(1−Z)·e^{k} + ½var_K·Phi_kk + ½(var_K + sig_r²)·Phi_ss + ½var_Z·Phi_ZZ − var_K·Phi_ks + cov_kZ·Phi_kZ − cov_kZ·Phi_Zs − (1/2xi)(L_d² + L_g² + L_r² + L_y²) } + xi·(e^{k+s}/varrho)·[1 − e^{−(Phi^{post} − Phi)/xi}].  FOCs: delta/c = phi_d'(i_d)·[1 + Phi_k − Phi_s − Z·Phi_Z]; delta/c = phi_g'(i_g)·[1 + Phi_k − Phi_s + (1−Z)·Phi_Z]; delta/c = psi0·psi1·i_r^{psi1−1}·e^{−psi1 s}·Phi_s. Post-tech regimes: drop s, i_r, and the jump term → 2-D Phi(k, Z) with the same SCC source. Value finiteness: the planner can always drive Z → 1 in finite time at finite cost, capping cumulative emissions, so V is finite despite g > delta along dirty paths; on the FD box this appears as the endogenous decarbonization of the high-k region.
economies.solution: FD-3D on (k, Z, s): k in [4, 7] (31), Z in [0.02, 0.98] (61), s in [−6, 0] (41); post-tech regimes 2-D (k, Z). Same PIBYS machinery as Economy 1 / fd_pdpt_v5_stable: finite-horizon discounted Feynman–Kac policy evaluation (T = 1200, dt = 2.5) with capped states at box edges (the e^{k} SCC source is bounded on the box, max |source| ≈ lambda1_eff·3.9e-5·e^{7} ≈ 0.19·delta at the severe calibration — well-scaled), closed-form FOC control updates including the explicit i_r*, relax + tail-average + interior-pocket stop + mutual-consistency gate. The cross-derivative structure (Phi_ks with cov = −var_K is the largest cross, O(1e-4)) is carried inside the rollout exactly as v5 carries V_{logK,Z}. UNIQUENESS/CONVERGENCE: identical argument to Economy 1 — the evaluated object is the expected-discounted-utility Feynman–Kac value, a delta-contraction fixed point on the compact box with explicit boundary treatment, certified by the consistency gate; not a residual-family member. Box-top sensitivity to the growing source is an explicit verification item (enlarge k-box to [4, 8], confirm interior insensitivity). Solve order: 2-D post-tech (per lambda1_eff variant needed for post-damage lifts, xi sweep) → 3-D pre-tech feeding Phi^{post} into the jump term. Roughly 6 lambda1_eff variants × 3 xi × (one 2-D + one 3-D) solves for OneJump; +interm layer for pi = 0.04.
economies.verification: (1) ALGEBRAIC EXACTNESS: sympy substitution of V = logK − b·Y + Phi(k,Z,s) into the full 4-D robust HJB; assert the Y coefficient is delta(b − lambda1_eff), zero at b = lambda1_eff identically in controls, and that all remaining terms are (k,Z,s)-measurable including the h_y-channel −(1/2xi)L_y² term. (2) UNREDUCED CROSS-CHECK: coarse 4-D FD of the unreduced economy (15^4, Y in [0,4]); verify V_4D + lambda1_eff·Y − logK is Y-flat (sup over Y-fibers ~ discretization error) and matches Phi — certifies the Y-elimination numerically. (3) TRUE-RESIDUAL + mutual-consistency gate on the 3-D grid, target <= 1e-3 interior. (4) RICHARDSON refinement on all 3 axes for v and all three policies. (5) CLOSED-FORM ANCHORS: (a) lambda1_eff = 0, post-tech: at Z→1 the exact corner i_g* = 0.12576, W0 = −0.1919 (verified above; matches the S1 sympy-exact memory), and the interior should reproduce the benchmarks/two_capital_deterministic FD; (b) perturbative SCC check: for small lambda1_eff, Phi(lambda1_eff) − Phi(0) should equal −lambda1_eff × (the Feynman–Kac integral of thetabar·eta·A_d(1−Z_t)e^{k_t} under the lambda1_eff = 0 policies) to first order — an independently computable linear-response line the FD must reproduce (this IS the GHKT SCC formula). (6) MONOTONICITY: Phi decreasing in lambda1_eff pointwise; i_d decreasing in k at fixed (Z,s) for lambda1_eff large (the scale-dependent mitigation signature); xi-monotonicity of the value.
economies.lift_map: At a production input x = (logK, Z, Y[, logR], lambda3, logxi-dups): k = clip(logK,[4,7]), s = clip(logR − logK, [−6,0]) (pre-tech), xi from the single deduped logxi, and lambda1_eff chosen per regime: pre-damage regimes use the pre-damage slope variant (lambda1 + lambda2·Y_ref); post-damage regimes map the lambda3 input to lambda1_eff(l) = lambda1 + lambda2(Y_ref − y_hat + y_bar) + lambda3·(Y_ref − y_hat), interpolating linearly across the solved variants. Then v_target(x) = logK − lambda1_eff·Y + Phi_regime(k, Z, s; xi) (trilinear on the FD grid, linear in logxi; repo ±logN transform applied as make_fd_anchor.py requires) — NOTE v is exactly LINEAR in the production Y input with slope −lambda1_eff, a deliberately distinct Y-signature. economies.name: Physical-Risk Green-Solow Economy (differential capital destruction, scale-free climate and innovation)
economies.tagline: Warming physically destroys dirty capital faster than green capital, and only the economy's carbon INTENSITY (not its scale) warms the planet — so the decarbonization transition is pure portfolio reallocation under physical risk, with no degrowth motive.
economies.coupling_design: Three coordinated swaps vs the production model, chosen jointly so EXACT logK-homogeneity holds (sympy-verified). (i) DAMAGE CHANNEL: the utility damage −δlogN(Y) is removed; instead temperature destroys capital at sector-specific rates Λ_j(Y)=γ_j·D(Y) subtracted from each sector's drift, with γ_d=1.0 > γ_g=0.25 (dirty assets — coastal plant, outdoor infrastructure — are more exposed: the Fried-2022/physical-risk channel). D(Y) mirrors the production marginal damage: pre-damage D=λ1+λ2·Y; post-damage-ℓ D=λ1+λ2·Y+λ3(ℓ)(Y−ŷ), so Λ_d(2°C)≈0.9%/yr, Λ_g(2°C)≈0.22%/yr. Consequences: the shadow cost of Y multiplies GROWTH rather than the utility level (V_logK pinned ≈1), and damages partially self-decarbonize composition (Z-drift gains +Z(1−Z)(Λ_d−Λ_g)>0) — a genuinely different incentive geometry: dirty capital is doubly penalized (it emits AND gets destroyed). (ii) CLIMATE CHANNEL: dY = Ê(Z)(θ̄dt+ς dW_y) with Ê(Z)=η̃·A_d·(1−Z), η̃=η·K₀=0.291·880=256.1 — emissions proportional to carbon INTENSITY at the reference scale (Green-Solow/balanced-growth normalization: efficiency growth offsets scale). Matches production's dY drift exactly at t=0 (≈0.02°C/yr) but kills the scale-warming feedback. (iii) INNOVATION: tech-jump intensity ℐ_g(s)=K₀e^s/ϱ with s=logR−logK (knowledge INTENSITY drives arrival) — equals production's R₀/ϱ at t=0. Everything else — AK production, log adjustment costs, log utility, the state-dependent damage-jump hazard 𝒥_n(Y), the λ3 grid, FULL robust preferences (all h and g channels, ξ) — kept identical to production. Economically this is the 'physical risk + composition-only climate' theory of the transition.

Jumps: tech (π=1, OneJump) A_g=0.1085→A_g''=0.1567 at intensity K₀e^s/ϱ (ϱ=746.67); damage jump at intensity 𝒥_n(Y)=r1(exp((r2/2)(Y−1.5)²)−1) revealing λ3(ℓ)∈{0..1/3}, L=5. CONTROLS: i_d, i_g, and i_r — all three active in pre-tech regimes (i_r drops post-tech, as in production); plus closed-form robust minimizers h=(h_d,h_g,h_y,h_r) and jump distortions g. Consumption C/K=(A_d−i_d)(1−Z)+(A_g−i_g)Z−i_r.

economies.solution: FD on the exact ≤3-D reduction, 4-regime backward ladder (OneJump): (1) PostD-PostTech: 2-D (Z,Y) × 5 λ3 × ξ-grid; (2) PreD-PostTech: 2-D with damage jump into (1); (3) PostD-PreTech: 3-D (Z,Y,s) × 5 λ3, tech jump into (1); (4) PreD-PreTech: 3-D with both jump terms into (2),(3). Scheme patterned on the verified benchmarks/post_damage_post_tech/fd_pdpt_v5_stable.py 3-D PIBYS: false-transient + Howard policy iteration, first derivatives upwinded on drift sign (Y-drift ≥0 ⇒ one-sided; no BC needed at degenerate Z edges since Z(1−Z)→0), centered second derivatives, the small O(σ²=1e-4) cross term a_Zs=Z(1−Z)²σ_d²−Z²(1−Z)σ_g² treated explicitly/lagged; controls updated pointwise per Howard step by 2-D Newton in (i_d,i_g) coupled through C/K plus the i_r inversion i_r=[(C/K)ψ0ψ1 e^{−ψ1 s}W_s/δ]^{1/(1−ψ1)} iterated to joint convergence. Grids: Z∈[0.01,0.99] (101), Y∈[0,4] (81; post-damage [2.5,4]), s∈[−6.5,−2] (61; s₀=log(11.2/880)=−4.36); ξ∈{0.05,0.1,∞} as solve-family parameter. Why unique/convergent: strictly discounted (δ=0.01>0) HJB with a monotone upwind discretization and monotone jump couplings (post-jump values enter with positive weights) ⇒ Barles–Souganidis convergence to the unique viscosity solution of each reduced PDE; the lagged cross-term perturbation is O(σ²) and controlled by refinement.
economies.verification: (i) Independent residual evaluator: fit a cubic spline to converged W and evaluate the ANALYTIC reduced-HJB residual via a separate autodiff code path at off-grid Sobol points; target RMS ≤1e-3 (production paper-grade units). (ii) Grid refinement: halve h in each dimension; confirm ~O(h) Cauchy convergence of W and all three policies. (iii) Analytic corner checks: at Z→1 (no emissions, single sector) the problem reduces to one-sector AK-log with algebraically known slope/policy (the memory-verified S1 algebra: unit logK-slope, scalar quadratic FOC for i_g); and the γ_d=γ_g=0, σ=ς=0 limit checked against benchmarks/two_capital_deterministic. (iv) Feynman–Kac Monte Carlo: simulate the full SDE+jump system under the FD policies from ~20 seed points and verify E[∫e^{−δt}δ(logC−…)dt] equals logK₀+W at the seeds within MC error (tests the whole regime chain, including levels — the quantity the DGM residual under-identifies). (v) Monotonicity of W in ξ and in λ3 across the solve family.

economies.name: GHKM-Romer Separable Economy (fossil-flow emissions, dirty-productivity damages, knowledge-in-production)
economies.tagline: A Golosov-Hassler-Krusell-Mitman-style theory of the transition: emissions are a cheap fossil FLOW choice with a constant optimal level, climate damages tax dirty-sector productivity, and R&D is ordinary Romer knowledge-in-production — the transition is green outgrowth plus damage-strangulation of the dirty sector under a flat carbon policy.
economies.coupling_design: Five swaps vs the production model, each an alternative theory ingredient and jointly delivering an EXACT closed form (sympy-verified residual ≡ 0). (i) AGGREGATION: Cobb-Douglas consumption over sector goods, U=δ[θ_d logC_d+θ_g logC_g] (imperfect substitutes vs production's perfect substitutes), with sector budgets C_d=(1−s_d)Y_d, C_g=(1−s_g−s_r)Y_g — separability is what makes two capitals + knowledge analytic. (ii) CLIMATE COUPLING: emissions come from a fossil FLOW input F — dirty output Y_d=A_d e^{−(γ0+γ1Y)}K_d^{1−ν}(χ_F F)^ν, dY=θ̄η₀F dt — carbon is burned fuel, capital stock does not emit; and damages are log-linear PRODUCTIVITY damages on the dirty sector only (not utility), hitting both dirty consumption and the financing of dirty investment (I_d=s_d Y_d), so warming endogenously strangles dirty accumulation. (iii) INNOVATION: knowledge is a Romer production input in the green sector, Y_g=A_g K_g^{1−β}(χR)^β — R&D raises green output continuously rather than buying jump-hazard lottery tickets; the breakthrough A_g→A_g''=0.1567 arrives at constant hazard ϖ_g=R₀/ϱ≈0.015. (iv) JUMP TREATMENT: constant hazards (damage hazard ϖ_n=𝒥_n(2.0)≈0.069 revealing slope γ1^ℓ=γ1+κλ3(ℓ); tech hazard ϖ_g) — the certainty-equivalent treatment that preserves linearity. (v) INVESTMENT TECHNOLOGY: log-log adjustment dlogX=[α_X+Γ_X log(θ_c I_X/X)]dt+σ_X dW_X, the θi≫1 limit of production's φ, with α_X recalibrated so drift matches production's φ at the reference i≈0.09. Interesting because it embeds the leading closed-form climate-macro tradition (GHKM flat-SCC) into the two-capital innovation setting: what if emissions were an intensive-margin flow and knowledge were ordinary capital?
economies.states_controls: States (logK_d, logK_g, logR, Y) with Process: dlogK_d=[α_d+Γ_d(logθ_c+log s_d+logA_d−γ0−γ1Y+νlog(χ_F F)−ν logK_d)]dt+σ_d dW_d (i.e. Γ_d log(θ_c I_d/K_d) with I_d=s_d Y_d); dlogK_g=[α_g+Γ_g(logθ_c+log s_g+logA_g+βlogχ+β(logR−logK_g))]dt+σ_g dW_g; dlogR=[α_r+Γ_r(logθ_c+log s_r+logA_g+βlogχ+(1−β)(logK_g−logR))]dt+σ_r dW_r (I_r=s_r Y_g: R&D funded from green output; the knowledge-capital gap logK_g−logR is mean-reverting ⇒ stable balanced growth); dY=θ̄η₀F dt (+ςη₀F dW_y, innocuous since V_YY=0). Jumps: damage at hazard ϖ_n reveals γ1→γ1^ℓ=γ1+κλ3(ℓ); tech at hazard ϖ_g lifts A_g→A_g''=0.1567. CONTROLS (four; three map to production nets): investment shares s_d, s_g, s_r∈(0,1) and fossil flow F>0. Calibration: θ_d=0.34 (t=0 dirty consumption-value share (1−Z₀)A_d/ᾱ), θ_g=0.66, β=ν=0.3, χ=K_g0/R₀≈55 and χ_F=K_d0/F₀ so both intensity ratios =1 at t=0 (making i_g(0), i_d(0) land at production magnitudes ≈0.065–0.08); γ1 pinned by the elegant identity: optimal warming rate μ_Y*=νδ/γ1, so γ1=0.15 reproduces the observed 0.02°C/yr; κ set so the post-damage slope matches production's (logN)_y at Y=2.75; η₀ then scales F* interior.

economies.name: JONES — scale-free semi-endogenous breakthrough economy
economies.tagline: The green transition is a scale-free innovation race (Jones-critique of Romer): breakthrough arrival depends on knowledge INTENSITY R/K, and climate responds to the carbon COMPOSITION of the economy, not its scale — so the planner's problem is exactly homogeneous in logK and the whole 4-state HJB collapses to 3-D.
economies.coupling_design: Two surgical changes to the production model, both scale-effect removals with real economic content. (1) INNOVATION: tech-jump hazard J_g = (1/ϱ_s)·e^{logR−logK} = (K0/ϱ)·(R/K) with ϱ_s = ϱ/K0 = 0.8485, instead of R/ϱ. This is the Jones (1995) semi-endogenous correction: a bigger economy does not mechanically get more breakthroughs; only knowledge per unit of capital matters. Calibrated so the hazard at the initial point (R0=11.2, K0=880) equals the production model's 0.0150/yr exactly (verified numerically). (2) CLIMATE: emissions in intensity form, E(Z) = η·A_d·(1−Z)·K̄ with K̄ = K0 = 880 frozen at calibration scale — the Kaya-composition theory of emissions: growth is emissions-neutral (scale offset by trend efficiency), only the dirty MIX (1−Z) warms the planet. Matches production initial emissions 10.01 and warming 0.0186 °C/yr exactly. Everything else — perfect-substitutes AK production, log adjustment costs, R&D technology ψ0(i_r)^{ψ1}·exp(ψ1(logK−logR)), damage function N(y;λ3), damage-jump intensity J_n(y), robustness ξ — is IDENTICAL to production. Economically interesting because it isolates the composition channel of decarbonization from the scale channel and prices the breakthrough as an option on knowledge intensity rather than on the absolute size of the R&D stock.

economies.solution: FD-3D. Exact dimension reduction proved by the substitution table (each HJB coefficient is a function of (Z,Y,s) only — this REQUIRES both scale-free modifications; the reduction is what makes the economy solvable). Solve order: 5× 2-D PostD-PostT → 1× 2-D PreD-PostT → 5× 3-D PostD-PreT → 1× 3-D PreD-PreT. Scheme: pattern-match the verified 3-D PIBYS solver benchmarks/post_damage_post_tech/fd_pdpt_v5_stable.py — policy-improvement (Howard) with Newton controls on the 3 FOCs + budget, monotone upwind discretization of first-order terms, centered second-order, false-transient stabilization, implicit linear solve per Howard sweep. Grid: Z∈[0.01,0.99]×61, Y∈[0,4]×41, s∈[−6.5,−1]×41 (s0=−4.364 interior); s-boundaries: Neumann at s_min (R&D super-productive limit), at s_max the hazard e^s/ϱ_s is large so the false transient pins W→W_postT (economically: imminent jump). δ=0.01 discount + monotone scheme ⇒ Barles–Souganidis convergence to the unique viscosity solution of the (degenerate elliptic) reduced HJB; the jump terms are bounded nonlocal couplings evaluated on already-solved downstream regimes, preserving monotonicity. Baseline solve at ξ=∞ (neutral); finite-ξ solves at ξ∈{0.1,0.05} reuse the same code with the closed-form h/g (all reduce, see HJB) for a 3-point logξ family.

(2) Grid refinement: halve h in each dimension, confirm ~O(h) convergence of W and policies. (3) Analytic limits: (a) at Z→1 with s large the problem approaches the known closed-form green BGP (i_g=0.1258, φ_g=0.0329, c=0.0309 — already verified against the repo's S1 derivation); (b) hazard→0 (s→−∞) with i_r=0 must reproduce the 2-D no-tech solve (internal consistency); (c) σ→0 solve vs the deterministic benchmark machinery in benchmarks/two_capital_deterministic/. (4) FOC residuals of the converged policies <1e-8 (Newton). (5) Monotonicity sanity: W increasing in s (knowledge good), decreasing in Y, W^ℓ decreasing in λ3.

economies.expected_distinctness: This map plants training at the exactly-homogeneous basin: v_logK = 1−W_s ≈ 0.9–1 everywhere, versus the production attractor's v_logK ≈ 0.37 (RUNA) and the FD-family member at 0.95 documented in the box-family finding — i.e., it seeds the high-marginal-value-of-capital, de-investment-capable basin from a DIFFERENT, independently-derived economy rather than from the production FD anchor itself. Its policies internalize climate purely through composition (V_Z large, V_y responding to Z), and its i_r field prices the breakthrough as an option on knowledge intensity (i_r increasing in W_s·e^{−s/2}, roughly flat in scale), unlike the production hazard which rewards absolute R accumulation — so the warm-start i_r and v_logR=W_s surfaces have visibly different slopes in logK (production: i_r benefit independent of logK given R; JONES: i_r benefit falls with logK given R). Distinct from zoo member ABSORB along every axis that matters: stochastic option-value innovation vs deterministic catch-up, perfect-substitutes aggregation vs Cobb-Douglas, corner-tolerant V_Z vs interior-attractor V_Z, state-dependent i_d(Z,Y,s) vs constant i_d.

economies.name: ABSORB — two-tree directed-absorption (Nelson–Phelps) catch-up economy
economies.tagline: The green transition is not a lottery but an engineering program: dirty and green services are Cobb-Douglas complements (two trees), and directed R&D DETERMINISTICALLY closes the green productivity gap via Nelson–Phelps absorption in knowledge intensity — no tech jump at all, closed-form capital blocks plus two 1-D problems.
economies.coupling_design: Three coupled design changes, each an alternative theory. (1) AGGREGATION: log C = β log C_d + (1−β) log C_g with β=0.34 (calibrated to the production model's initial consumption-value mix, A_d K_d0/(A_d K_d0+A_g K_g0)); dirty and green services are complements (unit elasticity), not perfect substitutes — dirty output is never fully abandoned, the transition is about green productivity catch-up, not dirty exit. This makes the sector problems SEPARABLE (each sector self-finances: C_d=(A_d−i_d)K_d, C_g=(A_g(s)−i_g−i_r)K_g — directed-technical-change budgeting: green researchers are paid in green output). (2) INNOVATION: the Poisson jump is replaced by a smooth embodied-technology ladder — green productivity is a function of knowledge intensity, A_g(s) with s = logR − logK_g, rising from 0.1085 to the breakthrough level 0.1567 as knowledge per green machine grows (Nelson–Phelps absorption / vintage capital: expanding K_g faster than R dilutes embodied productivity). R&D has certain returns; the option-value and jump-robustness economics vanish. (3) JUMP TREATMENT: no tech jump (deterministic ladder); the damage jump is kept but, by separability, shifts only the closed-form climate account. Climate is intensity-form (dY = ι(θ̄dt+ςdW), ι=ηA_d(1−Z0)K0=10.01) and hence uncontrollable — this member deliberately embodies 'climate orthogonal to allocation; transition driven by absorption + taste for variety', the cleanest possible foil to climate-directed basins.
economies.states_controls: States: logK_d, logK_g, logR, Y (4 states, fully separable — logR enters only through s=logR−logK_g, the exact reduction of the knowledge state). Process: dlogK_j = [φ_j(i_j)−½σ_j²]dt+σ_j dW_j, φ_j(i)=−0.035+0.06 log(1+16.7 i), j∈{d,g}; dlogR = [ψ0 i_r^{ψ1}e^{−ψ1 s}−½σ_r²]dt+σ_r dW_r with i_r ≡ I_r/K_g (so dR = ψ0 I_r^{ψ1}R^{1−ψ1}dt+σ_r R dW_r exactly as production, ζ=0), giving ds = [ψ0 i_r^{ψ1}e^{−ψ1 s}−½σ_r²−φ_g(i_g)+½σ_g²]dt+σ_r dW_r−σ_g dW_g; green productivity ladder A_g(s) = A_g⁰+(A_g″−A_g⁰)·[σ((s−s_m)/τ)−σ₀]/(1−σ₀), σ=logistic, τ=0.5, σ₀=σ((s0−s_m)/τ)=0.05, s_m = s0+τ·ln 19 = −2.535 (s0 = logR0−logK_g0 = −4.007), so A_g(s0)=0.1085 exactly and A_g→0.1567; dY = ι(θ̄dt+ςdW_y), ι=10.01; damage Poisson jump intensity (1/L)J_n(y) revealing λ3. Controls: i_d (dirty investment, own FOC), i_g (green investment), i_r (R&D, competes with i_g inside the green budget) — all three active. Preferences: δ[β log C_d+(1−β)log C_g] − δ log N(Y), ξ=∞ baseline (deterministic-tech theory paired with ambiguity-neutrality; documented).
economies.hjb: Additively separable value (verified by substitution): V = β logK_d + b_d + (1−β)logK_g + F(s) + w_dam(Y). (i) DIRTY BLOCK (algebraic): 0 = −δb_d + δβ log(A_d−i_d) + β[φ_d(i_d)−½σ_d²], FOC δβ/(A_d−i_d) = βφ_d′(i_d) ⇒ δ(1+θ i_d) = Γθ(A_d−i_d). (ii) GREEN/KNOWLEDGE BLOCK (1-D elliptic ODE in s): 0 = −δF(s) + max_{i_g,i_r≥0} { δ(1−β)log(A_g(s)−i_g−i_r) + [(1−β)−F′(s)][φ_g(i_g)−½σ_g²] + F′(s)[ψ0 i_r^{ψ1}e^{−ψ1 s}−½σ_r²] } + ½(σ_g²+σ_r²)F″(s). FOCs: δ(1−β)/c_g = φ_g′(i_g)[(1−β)−F′(s)] and δ(1−β)/c_g = ψ0ψ1 i_r^{ψ1−1}e^{−ψ1 s}F′(s), c_g = A_g(s)−i_g−i_r; F′>0 prices BOTH the return to R&D and the knowledge-dilution cost of green expansion (the [(1−β)−F′] wedge — a genuine anti-scale-up force absent from production). (iii) CLIMATE ACCOUNT: post-damage per ℓ: δw^ℓ = −δ[λ̃1(ℓ)Y+½λ̃2(ℓ)Y²+λ̃0(ℓ)] + ιθ̄ w^ℓ′ + ½ι²ς² w^ℓ″ with λ̃2=λ2+λ3(ℓ), λ̃1=λ1+λ2(ȳ−ŷ)−λ3ŷ (paper's post-damage quadratic); pre-damage: δw = −δ(λ1Y+½λ2Y²) + ιθ̄w′ + ½ι²ς²w″ + Σ_ℓ(1/L)J_n(Y)[w^ℓ(Y)−w(Y)] — damage-jump gains hit ONLY this block because capital/knowledge blocks are unchanged by the jump.

synthesis.diversity_argument: The five members are five recognizable, mutually exclusive theories of the decarbonization transition, each named to a literature: ABSORB = Nelson–Phelps embodied catch-up (deterministic engineering program, complements, climate-orthogonal allocation); RACE = Aghion–Howitt creative destruction (memoryless lottery purchased by R&D flow) crossed with Dell-Jones-Olken GROWTH damages and innovation-that-cools-the-drift; GHKM = Golosov et al. flat-SCC fossil-FLOW emissions with productivity damages strangling the dirty sector and Romer knowledge-in-production; JONES = the semi-endogenous critique (composition-not-scale drives both arrival and warming) with production's full damage-jump fear intact; PHYSRISK = physical climate risk destroying dirty assets faster than green ones. They span four distinct damage channels (utility level / growth rate / dirty productivity / capital destruction), four distinct innovation processes (deterministic ladder / no-stock race / knowledge-in-production with constant hazard / stock-intensity Poisson option), and both aggregation poles (perfect substitutes vs Cobb-Douglas complements). Map geometries are engineered to bracket every documented weak direction of the solution family: on V_logK — exactly 1 (ABSORB, RACE), 0.547 (GHKM), field ~0.95-1 (JONES, PHYSRISK) — bracketing the 0.37 attractor from above with a midpoint; on V_logR (the largest cross-run divergence channel per the loss-decomposition finding) — 0 (RACE) vs nonconstant F'(s) (ABSORB) vs constant 0.198 (GHKM) vs full W_s(Z,Y,s) fields (JONES, PHYSRISK); on V_Y — quadratic with jump anticipation / constant -0.100 steep / linear-with-f(Y;xi) / convex with jump kink / growth-shaped; on V_Z — interior-favoring log-shares vs corner-tolerant production shapes; on logxi geometry — flat (ABSORB) to order-of-magnitude policy profiles (RACE) to analytic-mild (GHKM) to FD families (JONES, PHYSRISK). Solution methods mix as required: RACE and GHKM analytic (RACE fully closed-form up to a scalar monotone root — the mandated analytic member), ABSORB closed-form blocks + 1-D FD, JONES and PHYSRISK verified 3-D FD. Finally the portfolio contains both FAR PAIRS (e.g. RACE vs JONES differ in every coupling) and one MINIMAL PAIR (JONES vs PHYSRISK: identical scale-free skeleton, one damage-channel swap), so if training preserves basin membership the readout attributes selection to a specific channel, and if the attractor eats everything, the five economically-labeled imprints make that the sharpest available negative result.

synthesis.verification_gates: A map may enter the chain launcher only when all six gates are green, recorded in its PROVENANCE json. G1 SPEC + ALGEBRA: the economy's Process -> HJB -> solution written in its README; sympy verification — closed-form members: full HJB residual identically zero (numeric spot check <= 1e-12 at 1e4 random states across xi x lambda3); FD members: reduction exactness (logK coefficient identically delta(1-A) forcing A = 1) proven symbolically. G2 SOLVE QUALITY: FD-3D — interior true-residual RMS <= 1e-3 (paper-grade), converged FOC residuals <= 1e-8, mutual-consistency gate passed, 3-level Richardson refinement showing ~O(h) Cauchy convergence of W and ALL THREE policies; 1-D members — residual <= 1e-10 with 400->1600 node refinement; RACE — fixed-point bracket Phi(0) > 0 > Phi(50) verified, root tolerance 1e-12. Additionally for FD members the UNREDUCED CROSS-CHECK: reconstruct V = logK + W and evaluate the economy's ORIGINAL 4-D HJB residual at 1e4 random (logK, Z, Y, logR) points — <= 1e-3 and logK-independent (any logK dependence flags an algebra bug). G3 ANCHORS + LIMITS: reproduce the sympy-exact S1 BGP corner where applicable (i_g'' = 0.12576, phi = 0.03289, c = 0.03094, W0 = -0.1919); xi = 148.4 vs drag-off neutral solve agreement O(1/xi); economy-specific limits (hazard -> 0 collapse to no-tech solve; kappa -> 0 kills q1 in RACE; ABSORB max_s F'(s) < 1-beta = 0.66; GHKM interiority s_d, s_g, s_r in (0,1), F* > 0, and comparative-statics signs). G4 LEVEL CERTIFICATE (mandatory for every member — the program's point): Feynman–Kac Monte Carlo — simulate the economy's own SDE + jump system under its solved policies from >= 20 seed points; realized discounted utility must equal V at the seeds within MC confidence bounds; this certifies the value LEVEL, exactly the quantity the DGM residual under-identifies. G5 LIFT INTEGRITY: production box image contained in the solved/analytic domain or a documented extrapolation rule; feasibility guard pass (C/K >= 1e-3 on a 1e5 LHS box sample, finite fields, exp arguments <= 35); anchor-fit RMSE targets per net before release; GRADIENT CONSISTENCY — autodiff of the fitted nets reproduces the map's v_logK, v_Z, v_logR within 5e-2 on a box sample (the imprint that selects basins is the gradients, so fitting v values alone is not accepted). G6 PROVENANCE: README spec complete, PROVENANCE json + MANIFEST written, RUNS.md row registered, the 2-3 required plots produced.
synthesis.risks: (1) 3-D FD execution risk (stiff jump sources up to ~8.7/yr at s = +2, W_sZ cross terms): mitigated by semi-implicit sinks, monotone splitting, and the Richardson gate; fallbacks are smaller pseudo-time steps, operator splitting, and as a last resort zeroing the O(1e-4) cross term with documentation. (2) The attractor may eat all five imprints under 300k gentle training (precedent: three FD anchors eaten in the box-family study); the zoo remains decisive — persistence curves quantify how each economically-labeled imprint dies, and the negative result 'the attractor overrides even exactly-solved distinct economies' is itself the deliverable; persistent-anchor training is the flagged follow-on, out of scope here. (3) Known level collapse (naked maps cannot hold the value level against the ~4.8 attractor): the zoo measures POLICY-basin selection; level rows are reported but expected to drift — do not oversell level control in the writeup. (4) RACE meets requirement (1) only via the discrete ladder-position state and an explicit relabeling (calibrated AH spec, not a reduction of the zeta = 0 R-process); if PIs object it degrades gracefully to an ablation arm since the other four members carry stock-based i_r. Note the critique's affine-hazard fix was checked and REJECTED (breaks the closed form via pre/post slope feedback) — GHKM's i_r-breakthrough decoupling stays a documented theory feature. (6) xi = 0.05 exponents (Delta/xi ~ 27) are within float64 but every lift and FD evaluation clips exp arguments at 35 per the repo overflow convention. (7) Effort creep on the FD members (~12 of the ~23 build days): the closed-form trio delivers the first three readout rows in week 1-2 while the harness matures, and PHYSRISK reuses the JONES harness as a coefficient swap. (8) Infra: group inode quota (npz-only outputs, no per-iteration dumps), the .git group-write ownership issue must be resolved before committing zoo code, and all solves/chains go through sbatch per repo convention.
